input.rationale: Section 12(b) gives us a TrueLink indemnity, but it is limited to TrueLink's breach of the Agreement or failure to perform: there is no duty to defend, no third-party intellectual property infringement indemnity for the Interface or hosted services, and nothing covering TrueLink's breach of law, unauthorised disclosure of our data or gross negligence/wilful misconduct. Searches confirm no IP infringement indemnity or warranty elsewhere (Sections 2 and 8 address only Client-side infringement risk), while Client's indemnity in 12(a) is very broad. This falls short of the playbook position, so we added the defence obligation, the IP and misconduct limbs, and a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink defence obligation and IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct indemnities, plus standard indemnity procedure.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity in Section 12(b) covers only its own breach of the Agreement and contains no protection against third-party intellectual property infringement claims arising from the Interface or hosted services, which our playbook treats as a critical requirement given we are licensing and reselling TrueLink's technology. We have added a duty to defend and indemnities for IP infringement, breach of law, unauthorised disclosure of Client data and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, together with a standard notice, control and cooperation procedure; if preferred, we can accept the usual IP indemnity exclusions (Client modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

ops.oldText: TrueLink shall indemnify and hold Client harmless
ops.newText: TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold Client harmless

ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim (i) arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder, (ii) alleging that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any other materials or services provided by TrueLink infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right of any third party, (iii) arising out of TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation, (iv) arising out of any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client or customer data caused by TrueLink, or (v) arising out of TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of any claim for which indemnity is sought, and the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement of such claim (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent), with the reasonable cooperation of the indemnified party at the indemnifying party's expense.
